We got search results with two templates. Need the one that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the reaction: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse to expel Cl- and base deprotonates N-H to give sulfonamide. So the target molecule is a sulfonamide (has S(=O)(=O)-N). The retrosynthetic step would break the N-S bond and form S-Cl bond (i.e., produce phenylsulfonyl chloride and aromatic amine). The template should be appropriate.

We have two results. Need to check which template matches our molecule. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with each template_id. The result includes template_id as integer? The search result gave reaction_id and template_hash, but template_id likely is reaction_id? Actually template_id is integer ID used to search. Probably reaction_id is the template ID. Let's try with first result reaction_id 214705. Use check tool.
